episode_summary: In this episode, Justin Black shares how he uses AI to optimize his online presence and generate high-value real estate leads. He discusses the importance of creating content that answers common client questions and how to leverage AI for SEO. Justin also provides insights into working with expired listings by sending personalized, high-value packages to stand out in the market.
